items.q: Why didn't Vinh just publish the workshop transcript?
items.a: A transcript is the **easy path**, and it was **not good enough**. A decent book is someone's **life's work**, not a dump of the class.

items.q: Why keep a story bank on tour?
items.a: Stories are how the lessons **come to life**, and ordinary moments **disappear** unless you document them.

items.q: How do you fight for a fading connection?
items.a: Say **'I miss you'** rather than **'want to catch up'**, and **go pursue** the connection you are missing.
**Record yourself, watch it back** with a trained eye, and only then decide **what to work on**.

items.q: Why not ask Claude for ten communication tips?
items.a: **General advice leads to general results.** Make your **own list of two to five** habits.

items.q: What is song vs instrument in speaking?
items.a: The **song** is the stories; the **instrument** is delivery. A good song can **carry a shaky first performance**.

items.q: What does Vinh's dad teach about vocal range?
items.a: Comfort can start by **matching volume and digging with someone**; later you still need the **assertive** keys.
The identity you are in is **cardboard, not cement**. Push a **slightly bigger box** instead of waiting to be discovered.

items.q: When someone you love asks you to speak, what is the point?
items.a: A wedding, funeral or goodbye is something **only you can do**. Better to speak **scared** than not speak.
